title: Flipcommons data patch
description: A small, source-attributed set of catalog claims and/or citation-source roots. Filename is NNNN-slug.yaml; the stem is the patch id. Authoritative validation happens in flipcommons' ingest_patches; this schema gives editors and CI an early structural check.

anyOf.description: A patch must carry a non-empty 'claims' or 'sources'.

note.description: Reason for the change; becomes a ChangeSet note. Shared by a flat entry and each `changesets:` item.

schemeIdentifier.description: Evidence keyed by a known scheme: ipdb:4443, opdb:GRhX5, youtube:O-2BXTXLXIY. The scheme prefix is not enumerated here on purpose — the authoritative scheme list lives in the flipcommons registry (apps/citation/citation_types/registry.py) and drifts as schemes are added; ingest validates the actual key. This is a structural shape check only. The one shape excluded is '//' right after the colon: a scheme://… string is a URL, not a scheme identifier, and only http(s) URLs are legal cite refs.

citeRef.description: A reference to the cited source, either as scheme:identifier (ipdb:4443, opdb:GRhX5, youtube:O-2BXTXLXIY) or an http(s):// URL (a standalone or domain-nested web source). Capped at 2000 chars to mirror the link column. A URL matching a known scheme's record pattern is rejected by ingest_patches in favor of the scheme:identifier form.

locator.description: Where in the source: a page, section, timestamp.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source: exact source text and '[...]' ellipses only. Interpretation, translation and rationale go in note: instead.

citeSpec.description: One citation: a bare cite-ref string, or a mapping widening it with an archive snapshot URL (http(s) refs only), a locator and a verbatim quote.

oneOf.description: Several separate sources backing this entry's claims. Every citation in the list attaches to every claim the entry asserts. The same source, locator and quote twice in one list is rejected by ingest_patches (judged on the parsed, normalized spec).

cite.description: External evidence: one cite spec or a non-empty list of them. Attaches the citation(s) to this entry's authored field claims (not create-owned slug/status).

propertyNames.description: A numeric handle, quoted as a string ('1'). Ephemeral authoring label wiring a [[cite:N]] marker to its source; minted to a durable citation at apply time.

cites.description: Inline-citation map declaring the NEW footnotes referenced from a markdown field (e.g. description) via [[cite:N]] markers. Each key is a numeric handle quoted as a string ('1'); each value is a cite-ref string or a { ref, archive, locator, quote } mapping — locator and quote land on the minted footnote instance, exactly like the entry-level cite. Existing-footnote markers ([[cite:<slug>]]) self-resolve and take no entry here. Marker<->map correspondence and cite resolution are validated authoritatively by ingest_patches.

retract.description: Scalar/FK field names whose claim from this patch's source should be removed. Not valid with create.

remove.description: Relationship members to remove: a mapping of relationship namespace to a list of member values — FK public_ids (e.g. {location: [germany]}), bare strings for aliases/abbreviations (e.g. {manufacturer_alias: [Stern Inc]}), or one-key 'key: value' mappings for multi-key relationships (e.g. {credit: [{john-youssi: art}]} — person public_id -> role public_id).

attribution.description: Source slug; must already exist in flipcommons. A patch attributes to the source the fact came from (e.g. flip-museum, flipcommons-catalog, ipdb, opdb) and supersedes or retracts that source's own claim.

description.description: Freeform rationale (the why). Copied to the IngestRun note.

claims.description: Ordered list of operations; each entry is a single-key mapping (entity ref -> fields). An entry may group several changesets on one record under a single header via `changesets:` (the ref declared once).

^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9/-]*$.description: Fields to assert on this entity. Reserved keys (directives, not claim fields): create, delete, expect, retract, remove, note, cite, cites, changesets.

allOf.description: create is exclusive with delete and the edit-only directives (retract/remove).
delete is footprint-exclusive — no retract/remove/changesets companions.

create.description: Opt-in to create the entity when its public_id does not resolve.

delete.description: Soft-delete the entity (status -> deleted) through the delete planner. Not valid with create.

expect.description: Legacy drift guard, now accepted-but-ignored: still permitted so older patches that carry it validate, but it no longer guards anything. Omit it in new patches.

changesets.description: Companion changesets on the same record. Each item is edit-shaped (note/cite/cites/retract/remove + authored fields) and becomes its own ChangeSet, inheriting the header's ref. Lifecycle (create/delete) lives on the header, not here.

sources.description: Citation-source roots to upsert (the `sources:` block) — books, magazines or websites that later `cite:` entries hang under. Each is flat (no nested children); create child sources via `cite:` on a claim. Field values are validated authoritatively against the model in ingest_patches.

identifier_key.description: Marks a scheme root whose children carry structured identifiers. The scheme key is not enumerated here on purpose — the authoritative list lives in the flipcommons registry (apps/citation/citation_types/registry.py) and drifts as schemes are added; ingest validates the key and holds the root to the scheme's registered facts. Root sources only; the root's source_type must be the scheme's owning type. Omit the field (or set it to "") for a non-scheme (schemeless) root.

domains.description: Extra recognition hosts for this root, beyond its 'homepage' link — a rebrand's old domain, a .com/.co.uk pair, an asset/CDN host. One publication reachable at several registrable hosts stays one root all of them recognize. Each entry is a bare host or full URL ('oldpin.com' or 'https://oldpin.com/'); stored verbatim (no rounding), gated only against IP literals and bare public suffixes. Web roots only.

links.description: URLs where a reader can inspect the source. A root needs a 'homepage' link for domain-based URL recognition.
